name: El Forge Limited
about: El Forge Limited manufactures and sells steel forgings for the automobile industry in India. The company offers fuel injection forgings, steering rods, tie rods, engine and gear boxes, starter items, common and hot forged rails, levers for vehicles braking systems, closed die forgings, light duty crankshafts, connecting rods, rocker arms, transmission parts, wheel hubs, valve parts, claw poles, and sockets for ball joints. It also provides computer aided design, manufacture, and engineering services. The company also exports its products to the United States and China. El Forge Limited was incorporated in 1934 and is based in Chennai, India.
